messages:
Nina Park: Heads-up: partner reported a P0 from their marketplace listing — customers seeing OOMs on inference nodes. Need to confirm routing. Do we use the public #partnerships channel or start a private warroom?
Tobias Müller: Private warroom for P0s please. Post an ACK in the shared channel and link the warroom. Keeps noise down for SRE. :loud_sound:
Ravi Singh: Agreed. Quick checklist I use: 1) ACK publicly, 2) create private channel `#market-sev-<partner>-p0`, 3) add vendor POC + account manager + eng oncall, 4) attach Grafana + logs, 5) open PagerDuty vendor escalation if no ACK in 10m.
Claire Wu: For SI partners (managed deployments) we also need ops credentials & support window info in the first message — they often require an elevated support token.
Sebastian Ortega: Can someone confirm whether the marketplace listing auto-provisions dedicated infra? If yes, we must include customer org ID and infra IDs immediately.
Marketplace Oncall: Rule: if incident originates from a marketplace listing -> treat as external-facing incident. Create warroom, notify @Marketplace Oncall, and set priority to P0/P1 based on customer impact. Add `marketplace_listing_id` tag.
Nina Park: Drafting a minimal warroom starter below so it's consistent across partners. Please comment.
Nina Park: ```
/create-channel #market-sev-vertexai-p0 private
Topic: P0 - VertexAI listing OOMs
Participants: @Marketplace Oncall, @NinaPark, @RaviSingh, @TobiasMuller, @ClaireWu, <vendor_poc>@vendor.com
Bridge: +1-800-555-0100 (pin 6789)
Initial Post: 
- Impact: X customers (count) / Y requests failing
- Start time (UTC): 2026-03-21T14:12:00Z
- Affected infra: region:us-west-2; cluster: cluster-44; instance IDs: i-0abc, i-0def
- Model runtime: fp16, batch_size=8, quantized: no
- Immediate steps taken: instance repro, driver logs attached, core dumps collected
- Vendor ask: remote diag + firmware check + advise swap procedure
- Escalation policy: vendor ACK 10m -> vendor-eng PD at 15m -> partner AM + AE notified at 20m
Tags: env:prod, marketplace_listing_id:98765, si_managed:true
```
Tobias Müller: Suggestion: include a quick 'who owns what' line in the template: EngOncall = evidence + triage; PartnerOps = vendor comms; AE = customer comms. Saves confusion during handoffs.
Ravi Singh: Also add a bullet for SI partners: "is there a standing ETR SLA with partner?" If yes, include SLA window and replacement ETA expectations.
vendor-bot: Vendor ticket created: VND-8821. Vendor ACK received (ETA for first response: 22m).
Claire Wu: Vendor ACK is slow here. If vendor ETA > 15m we should loop in vendor-eng PD and the partner's escalation matrix. Do we have PD for each major HW vendor?
Nina Park: We have PD routing for main vendors: Nvidia, Supermicro, CloudVendorX. I'll add the vendor PD numbers to the shared playbook.
Sebastian Ortega: For marketplace-caused issues, sales/legal sometimes ask for provisional credits rapidly. PartnerOps, please hold off on credits until we confirm root cause (HW vs model).
Marketplace Oncall: Note: If dedicated nodes are affected and it's an infra failure, add `dedicated_customer_id` to the warroom and tag eng-sre. For marketplace transient failures we keep product-marketplace in the watchers list.
Ravi Singh: One more: for SI integrations we need to capture whether the SI deployed a custom agent version. If so, include agent version + checksum. That often changes vendor triage.
Tobias Müller: I'll add an automation to pre-populate the initial post with telemetry links (Grafana links, logs, recent deploys) when the warroom is created.
Nina Park: Great. I'll update the Partner SEV Playbook with this template + escalation timings and push a changelog. ETA: EOD Friday.
Claire Wu: Can we also document the expected timeline for opening an external vendor RMA (if hardware)? E.g., vendor RMA initiated within 24h after confirmed HW failure, barring supply issues.
Ravi Singh: Yep, add RMA steps and owner: PartnerOps owns RMA comms; Eng handles evidence.
Nina Park: Thanks all. If anyone has vendor PD numbers or SI support tokens, drop them into the forthcoming playbook so PartnerOps can copy them into new warrooms.
Marketplace Oncall: Adding watchers: eng-sre, product-marketplace, partner-ops for first 60 mins.
Nina Park: Ok I'll start using this as standard. Closing thread for now — will post the playbook link when done. :white_check_mark:
